answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Praised art dealer licence with art dealers attestation. It demands a licence dealers renew after canvas audits, and the zenith is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the plume compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the pulse is that the farm's unit economics never work.
